question: In January 2022, the Punjab and Maharashtra Co-operative bank has been merged with which bank?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Unity Small Finance Bank**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Punjab and Maharashtra Co-operative Bank** has been merged with **Unity Small Finance Bank** in January 2022.
 
• This merger was a significant step to safeguard the interests of the depositors of Punjab and Maharashtra Co-operative Bank.
 
• Unity
